_meta.description: The four separation principles for physical contradictions (element E must be P and not-P), each with the inventive principles most often linked to it. The links are a common teaching grouping, not part of the 1971 matrix, and differ a little between sources.

separations.question: Can E be P at one moment and not-P at another?
Can E be P in one place and not-P in another?
Can E be P under one condition and not-P under another?
Can the whole be P while its parts are not-P, or the reverse?
